about_product: 12Lb Large Capacity for Outdoor Feeding: this bird feeder squirrel proof holds up to 12 pounds of bird seed, suitable for feeding multiple small birds at once; Large capacity means fewer refills and continuous enjoyment in your garden or backyard, fit for a variety of bird seeds including millet, black oil sunflower seeds, striped sunflower seeds, corn kernels, safflower, and more; The bottom has a perforated design to ensure the seeds stay dry inside

Smart Weight-activated Squirrel Proof Design: features an innovative weight-sensitive mechanism that automatically closes feeding ports when heavier animals like squirrels climb on, ensuring only birds can access the seeds

Durable All-metal Construction: made of alloy steel, this squirrel resistant bird feeder is rustproof, weather-resistant, and built to last; Sturdy housing effectively prevents damage from animals and harsh outdoor conditions, The metal parts are treated with a rust-resistant, matte powder coat finish, and the roof provides shelter from rain and snow

Clear Window for Seed Level Monitoring: the transparent polycarbonate window lets you easily check the remaining seed level at a glance — no need to guess or forget refills, keeping your bird friends fed all the time

Gift for Bird Lovers; : you can enjoy watching your favorite birds like cardinals, chickadees, finches, and jays up close, makes an excellent gift for BIRD LOVERS, Ideal for Garden, Yard Bird Lovers, ideal for gardens, patios, and backyards; Great for bird watchers, nature lovers, and families wanting to enjoy wild birds up close

top_reviews.review_comment: I received the feeder in a box that stated it was part of a 2 box set-do not sell separately. Only feeder was in the one box with no supplies to mount the feeder. By the way it was rewrapped it was obviously returned prior to being sent to me. NOT AS ADVERTISED!!! AN ADDENDUM: After being up for one day the squirrels have already managed to get 3 of the 4 screws out. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY.
top_reviews.review_date: Reviewed in the United States on March 28, 2026

top_reviews.review_title: Bent from the factory cheaper version of other similar bird feeders
top_reviews.review_comment: The bird feeder came from the factory bent the box was not damaged so that tells me it was more than likely assembled that way at the factory. The metal seems a little flimsy but otherwise it looks pretty solid. This does not come with a pole mounting base at all, it only has four screws to attach a mounting base. There is no way to mount this with anything in the package. Also this does not have adjustable springs like other bird feeders that look similar to this like the Duncraft Absolute II Bird feeder. This looks like a cheaper knock off of that particular bird feeder even though it's almost the same price.
top_reviews.review_date: Reviewed in the United States on March 29, 2026

top_reviews.review_title: Great Feeder But Missing The Essentials
top_reviews.review_comment: Great feeder overall, but a bit disappointing for the price. It works exactly as expected and was easy to figure out even without instructions, but it really should include the pole instead of requiring a separate purchase. That said, the large capacity is a big plus, and the squirrel-proof design does its job well. The sturdy metal construction feels durable and built to last, and the clear window makes it easy to keep track of seed levels. Once set up, it's a solid addition to any yard—just wish it came more complete out of the box.

top_reviews.review_title: This one is a No from me
top_reviews.review_comment: I really wanted to like this squirrel-proof bird feeder, but it ended up being a bit disappointing. The biggest issue is the spring mechanism—it doesn't actually work as intended, it stays stuck down when their is weight so it has to be manually opened back up. Which makes it super annoying That said, there are a couple of positives. The large 12lb capacity is a major bonus, especially if you don't want to refill it constantly. It's convenient and holds plenty of seed for extended use. Also worth noting: the product description is accurate in stating that no pole is included, so be aware you'll need to purchase or already have one separately. Overall, decent capacity, but the main feature doesn't deliver, which makes it hard to recommend.
top_reviews.review_date: Reviewed in the United States on April 13, 2026

top_reviews.review_title: Don't waste your time unless you want to somehow fabricate a pole to mount it
top_reviews.review_comment: Well.. Not as described in text or picture. No pole to mount even though the delivery box mentions a second box. It did come with the four screws to mount, but they were bouncing around at the bottom of the box. This looks so similar to one that I see at our local gardening Center. It was hoping he'd be the same quality, but this is a very thin, easy benable metal. In fact, the roof is already bent from the factory. The spring-loaded mechanism to keep squirrels off seems like a light squirrel could easily get on without triggering it as there's no adjustment. I probably would attract birds but returning it for a inferior product And no way to mount it except sitting on the floor or ground
top_reviews.review_date: Reviewed in the United States on April 10, 2026

top_reviews.review_comment: This big birdfeeder has unfortunately been a big disappointment. This feeder is huge! It's made of metal with weight activated pedal-like covers to protect the seed from squirrels. The design requires 2 pieces of plexiglass-glass. The box I received only had one, making the feeder useless as it cannot hold birdseed. The top opens on a hinge and the hinge on mine is bent. The feeder must be mounted on a pole.the hardware for attaching was taped inside of the packing box ( I almost missed it) and torn as though it had been opened previously. The hardware that was included is 4 very short screws. I would be wary of such minimal hardware with a birdfeeder of this size. As an avid birder who enjoys my feeders I really wanted this one to be a part of my backyard. For the price/value I have not been happy and I would not recommend this feeder.
top_reviews.review_date: Reviewed in the United States on April 11, 2026
